== Biography ==
There is no birth record present for Andrew, we can see in Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian, Scotland that 'Andro Glasgow' appears as the Father's name on several Christining records in the ''"Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950"'', database. 

* [[Glasgow-1493|Bessie  Glasgow (bef.1666-)]] 
* [[Glasgow-1026|William  Glasgow (bef.1671-)]] 

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1087]] is assessed at 28% (uncertain). Andrew’s Kirknewton children in 1666 and 1671 establish him as a father but do not identify his own parents. William-1087’s 1609 generation could fit a son around 1645, making the inherited local-family placement possible; no held record joins the men.

Uncertain28%; estimated generation and locality, without repurposing Andrew’s children as evidence of his father.

Next useful test: Locate Andrew’s marriage or a family property clause.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-1319 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-1319]. No new original inspected; no new father attached.


=== Current research ===

Andrew is a legitimate record-defined father: Kirknewton baptism indexes name Andrew/Andro Glasgow as father of Bessie in 1666 and William in 1671. The latter is [[Glasgow-1026|Glasgow-1026]], so that father-child link is direct rather than a naming-pattern reconstruction.

No inspected record identifies Andrew's wife, parents, birth or death. His <code>about 1645</code> birth is a demographic estimate from the 1666 child, and the structured link to [[Glasgow-2453|William-3515]] rests only on locality and naming. It should not be treated as proved.
